note: Patchify + linear project, treated as one strided-conv-as-matmul. Fixed-size single pass -- no loop, unlike the spec-decode workload.
Standard MHA (ASSUMED, no GQA) -- 16 heads x 80 dim.

FULL bidirectional self-attention -- every patch attends to every other patch, no causal mask, no window. Quadratic in num_tokens, which itself is quadratic in image resolution -- a steeper wall than the text model's windowed-by-default local layers.
MLP up-projection, single matmul (GELU, not SwiGLU -- no gate).
Cross-modal projection: d_vis=1,280 -> d_model=6,656 so image tokens can join the main LM's context (feeds into task A's prefill in the text workload).
